evidence.quote:
In terms of the attitudes, I am no statistician to check the validity of the argument in drawing the
statistical and regression analysis, and I have noted this. I can say that the attitudes are somewhat
what I'd expect, it's worth adding that women may be have a lower income and thus due to their
lower socioeconomic position they may feel more worried about poverty and inflation, so this is
could be mentioned in terms of analysing the results.

We also have added a reference
explaining how income differences between males and females may influence their
different perceptions regarding poverty and inflation because of the war.
